name: @dharmax/llm-utils
description: Small LLM primitives for typed provider execution, structured responses, routing, prompts, context, sessions, and metrics.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --sourcemap --resolve-extensions=.ts,.tsx,.js,.json --external:zod --external:node:fs/promises --external:node:fs --external:node:path --external:node:url --external:node:child_process --external:node:util && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test

author: dharmax
